title: It's Surprisingly Easy to Survive an Orbital Strike
description:
Well... I'm not really debunking the orbital strike canon ITSELF... I kind of wanted to answer the question of "How hard is it to survive a blast from one of Minecraft's aforementioned deadliest weapons (according to every scripted SMP)," and uh... well it wasn't that hard let's just say... This was made in an hour and I kinda made it for fun! Not too serious lol
